Finding F3. Raw SQL: a guarded pre-check (RAISE EXCEPTION, no row modified) refuses to apply if a case-variant duplicate email already exists, then creates IX_Users_Email_Lower on lower(Email). Forward-fix (resolve the duplicate, re-run); the pre-existing case-sensitive IX_Users_Email is left in place, so Down only drops the new index.

Finding F4. Five CHECK constraints on Properties (Area/Rooms/ColdRent/WarmRent/PurchasePrice), each `col IS NULL OR col > 0` -- no column type/nullability change. Fails atomically (no row modified) if an existing row already violates one; run scripts/database/audit-f4-numeric-constraints.sql first. Down drops the constraints.
Finding F7. Two new nullable columns plus a filtered index for the account-deletion delay-window sweep; application rollback may leave them unused.

Index-only (pg_trgm GIN on Properties.Title/Description for the ILIKE keyword search). No data change; if a query-plan or write-latency regression appears, drop the two indexes (concurrently) and forward-fix.

Makes ShortStayListings.Latitude/Longitude nullable and, via raw SQL, nulls out the (0,0) placeholder pin every listing got before the create form had location fields.
